speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the nature of your itching and fatigue better. Have you noticed any yellowing in your eyes or skin, or changes in your urine and stool color? Additionally, have you experienced any itching at night specifically?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; your history of ulcerative colitis and high-risk sexual behavior raises concerns for Hepatitis C or biliary obstruction from sclerosing cholangitis. Has anyone in your immediate family been diagnosed with primary biliary cholangitis or primary sclerosing cholangitis? REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis Serology panel (A, B, C), AMA M2 antibody, and IgG4 levels.

speaker: Doctor
text: The liver function tests confirm a cholestatic pattern with elevated alkaline phosphatase but normal bilirubin; given your history of ulcerative colitis, do you have a family history of inflammatory bowel disease, and have you noticed any pale stools or dark urine recently? REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC). The combination of cholestatic liver enzymes, severe pruritus, scleral icterus, and a history of ulcerative colitis is classic for PSC. Please proceed with an MRI of the abdomen with MRCP to visualize the biliary tree for characteristic "beading" or strictures.
